title: shortcut namespace file
description: A .shortcut file: one namespace of shortcuts, in format version 2. Only the last entry in 'args' can set 'rest'; the schema doesn't check that, but shortcut does.

description.description: Description of the namespace. Shown in 'list'.

shortcuts.description: The shortcuts in this namespace, by name.

entry.description: One shortcut. Needs exactly one of 'inline' and 'script'.

script.description: Path to a script. A relative path starts at this file's folder and can't escape it. An absolute path is used as it is.

cwd.description: Where it runs: 'caller', a path relative to this file's folder, an absolute path, or a path starting with ~. Default 'caller'.

icon.description: Freedesktop icon name for a desktop launcher. Default 'utilities-terminal'.

required.description: Refuse to run when this argument is missing and has no default.

default.description: Value used when the argument is missing.

desc.description: A note for people reading the file. Nothing prints it.

rest.description: Take all remaining arguments. Last entry only.
